output.subject: Your complaint about your personal loan application
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for contacting us about your personal loan application. We have received your complaint.

You told us your application was declined and that the letter you received said your debt-to-income ratio was too high. You mentioned that you recently bought a car, and that you have been a customer for eleven years without ever bouncing a check. You feel the decision was unfair because it looked at one number rather than your whole relationship with us. You asked for someone to review that full relationship, and you asked whether there is an appeal process.

We understand how disappointing a decision like this can be, especially after so many years with us, and we're sorry for the frustration it has caused.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint, including both of your questions, and will respond to you within 10 business days.

Thank you for your patience, and for being with us for the past eleven years.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Mode is acknowledge only: draft takes no position on the denial or on reconsideration.
Draft does not say whether an appeal or reconsideration process exists; the specialist team should answer this directly.
Draft does not confirm the eleven-year tenure or payment history; these are the customer's account.
Check that the denial letter the customer received included the stated reason and any required disclosures.
Customer's tone is reasonable and they accept the debt-to-income reason; consider whether a holistic review or reapplication guidance is appropriate.
